name: Gulmohar at The Bagh
why_it_matters: Garden-set restaurant inside The Bagh heritage resort — orchard surroundings, multi-cuisine spread, and the closest higher-end dining stop to Keoladeo. One of the few sit-down options in Bharatpur with proper hotel-trained kitchen output.
insider_tip: If you're staying inside Keoladeo at the lodge, Gulmohar is a 15-minute auto ride out — book a table at sunset and they'll seat you in the orchard, not the indoor hall.
signature_address: The Bagh, Agra-Achnera Road, Bharatpur, Rajasthan 321001

name: Amritara Chandra Mahal Haveli Restaurant
why_it_matters: Heritage haveli built circa 1699 by Mughal-era nobility, now run by Amritara as a 11-room boutique stay — in-house indoor restaurant plus a poolside outdoor venue called Peharsi Andaaz. Sits 25 km from Bharatpur city in Peharsar village.
insider_tip: Non-residents need to call ahead — the property runs as a private hideaway and walk-in lunches aren't accepted on most days.
signature_address: Amritara Chandra Mahal Haveli, Peharsar Village, near Bharatpur, Rajasthan 321001

name: Maharo Thikano
why_it_matters: Rajasthani village-theme resort-restaurant on Agra Road — fixed-price entry includes welcome drink, snacks, full thali dinner, plus Kalbeliya, Ghoomar, puppet show, magic and camel/horse rides. Built for the Bharatpur tour-bus circuit.
insider_tip: Adult entry around ₹450 covers the dance-and-dinner package; à la carte isn't really the play here. Time the visit to start at 7 pm to catch the full show sequence.
signature_address: Maharo Thikano, Agra Road, Vill-Chichina, near petrol pump, Bharatpur, Rajasthan 321001

name: Hotel Bharatpur Ashok (Forest Lodge) Restaurant
why_it_matters: ITDC-run lodge inside Keoladeo National Park, 1.5 km from the main gate — the only sit-down restaurant actually inside the wetland. Useful when birders want a hot meal without leaving the park.
insider_tip: The veranda tables face the wetland — finish breakfast there and you can spot painted storks and pelicans without leaving your chair.
signature_address: Hotel Bharatpur Ashok (Forest Lodge), inside Keoladeo National Park, Bharatpur, Rajasthan 321001
